name: sair
description: Run Android instrumented tests on real phones, or lease one: install APKs, run shell commands, take screenshots, read logcat.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run an app's instrumented tests on a real phone and return per-test results

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the phones this API key may use (serial, model, API level, shared, in use)

tools.name: lease_device
tools.description: Take a real phone for several calls

tools.name: install_apk
tools.description: Install an APK on the leased phone

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command on the leased phone

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the leased phone

tools.name: logcat
tools.description: Read recent logcat lines from the leased phone

tools.name: release_device
tools.description: End a lease: uninstall what it installed and free the phone
